data.title: Half-Inch Ruler Challenge
data.description: Practice measuring shapes to the nearest half-inch by carefully reading the tick marks on the ruler.

challenges.label: Purple Rectangle
challenges.hint: Count the big tick marks from 0 to the edge of the shape.

challenges.label: Blue Square
challenges.hint: Find the number on the ruler where the shape ends.

challenges.label: Sky Rectangle
challenges.hint: The small marks between the numbers are halves. Count carefully.

challenges.label: Red Rectangle
challenges.hint: Measure from 0, not from 1. Where does the shape end?
